tasks.title: Set up PostgreSQL database schema with products, inventory, alerts, and sales tables
Implement WebSocket server infrastructure for real-time inventory synchronization
Build barcode scanning interface with camera integration and product lookup API
Create Dashboard Home screen with stats grid, quick actions, and recent activity
Develop Inventory List screen with search, filters, and product cards
Implement real-time inventory tracking with automatic stock updates on transactions
Build low stock alert system with threshold configuration and notification triggers
Create Product Detail screen with stock adjustment and edit capabilities
Develop Alerts Dashboard with filtering, severity levels, and resolution actions
Implement Product Management CRUD operations with form validation
Build Sales Reporting screen with date filtering and top products analytics
Design and implement responsive bottom navigation and mobile-first UI components

risks: WebSocket connection stability may cause synchronization delays across multiple users in poor network conditions
Barcode Scanner API compatibility varies across mobile devices and browsers requiring fallback mechanisms
Real-time inventory updates under high concurrent transaction load could create race conditions without proper locking
PostgreSQL performance may degrade with large product catalogs without proper indexing on search and filter queries
Mobile camera permissions and barcode scanning accuracy depend on device hardware capabilities and lighting conditions
